title: Mixed Event — Connect Hearts Message — Episode7 Feelings of Gratitude

meta.Event Outline: The second-years at Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy are assigned a work shadowing program. Interested in learning about making fun memories for visitors, Saki, Emu and Shiho choose to visit an event planning company.

rows.Line: Several dozen minutes later
Event Venue

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: I've finished writing my message.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Congratulations!
Your card is all set to go now♪

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line:
Yeah, but...
It still looks a little dull, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't see anything wrong with a simple design, but I do see your point. You still have plenty of space left.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: I feel like I should add some more decorations that glitter and sparkle, since she likes those kinds of things. I just don't have much of a sense for that kind of thing myself.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay.
Glittery and sparkly...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, what about these rhinestones?!

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: Rhinestones?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yes! You could write her name using them, or create her favorite shapes and such!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, this smiley face might also be a nice touch!

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line:
I see...
These would brighten things up a lot.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Exactly! Also...
<Sakki... Sakki, can you hear me?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry, I'll just be a moment!
se_run_women_003_1

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hi, Rin! You came to visit?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehe. I've been taking quick peeks here and there, because you two have been so busy♪>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Anyway, if you wanna make her card really shine, then why not use the you-know-what?>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The what? Oh, the sparkly masking tape?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah! She could create an outer border for her card. Or some cute stars and hearts and stuff!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Throw in the rhinestones you just suggested, and her card's gonna shine like crazy☆>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, good point!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, Rin! I'll try suggesting that!
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_women_003_2

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Let's see... Saki and Shiho should be...
Oh, there they are!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hi, Emu! Thanks for going out to advertise for us!
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_women_003_2

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line: Oh, this is where the event's taking place?

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line: So, uhh... There's something I wanna give you.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: Yeah, me too...

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line:
I know we fight all the time...
But thank you for sticking with me.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line:
Huh? This card...
It's so sparkly and cute!!
Did you put these stickers on yourself?

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line:
This card's also really cute...!
There's stationery, donuts and all my other favorite things.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line: That girl over there showed me what to do. You have no idea how hard it was to get everything to balance out.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line:
I also wrote you a message...
Thanks for always looking out for me.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line: I... I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (They both look so happy...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm glad they could both make their feelings known.)

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: Umm... Thanks for helping us out like this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No, I'm just glad that she ended up liking it so much!

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: Me too. We've been together for so long that I think I started to take her for granted...

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: So, I'm glad that I got a chance to thank her for being my friend.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler B
rows.Line:
Thank you so much!
Making that card was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I also had a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: Thank you all very much.
se_walk_women_003_1
se_walk_women_003_2
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Alright, now that we've finished cleaning everything up, this event is officially over. Thank you all for your hard work.

rows.Speaker: Emu, Saki & Shiho
rows.Line: Thank you for having us!

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: I even received word from Saishi Kobo that we did a wonderful job of promoting their new products.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, that's great...!

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line:
Yes, thank you all again.
As a reward, would you all like to take home some of the products we had on display here today?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, we're allowed to do that...?

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Yes. The other employees were impressed by how passionately you all spoke about Saishi Kobo's products with the guests.

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: If anything, I'm inclined to believe that they'd want you to take whatever you like.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
In that case, we accept.

rows.Speaker: Kizaki
rows.Line: Excellent. We have everything set up in the back, so please make sure to stop by before you head out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'm so glad we got to help out with this event...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Working with all those guests and showing them how great Saishi Kobo's products really are was so much fun...)

rows.Speaker: Male Guest
rows.Line: It's nice, making a card with someone specific in mind. It makes it easier to put your feelings into it...

rows.Speaker: Male Guest
rows.Line: I can't wait to give this to my wife.

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: Me too. We've been together for so long that I think I started to take her for granted...

rows.Speaker: Female High Schooler A
rows.Line: So, I'm glad that I got a chance to thank her for being my friend.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (Come to think of it...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (There are a ton of people who I haven't really had a chance to thank properly yet.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho! Emu!
